comment: The Haro v0.25 conformance floor, written BEFORE the court that passes it (the W discipline: fixtures first, prose second). v0.25 grows v0.24 by the first two weaves (ZC4 of the constitution plane, on the author's 'Start ZC4', 2026-11-02): sovereignty (W3) and privacy (W4) are judged at the declaring altitude over the PERSONAL seats a constitution names, each at the SEVERITY the WEAVES clause declares -- constitutional refuses, governance warns, advisory notes -- and every refusal names the article it serves (Art. 5 organizational_sovereignty) and the declared REGIME's own article: GDPR where the world declares gdpr, Niger Law 2017-28 where it declares niger_2017_28, the regime by its declared name where Haro has no article table, 'no regime declared' where there is none -- never a default. The three paths a personal seat may not reach ungoverned are the ones a language declares: the voice (W4.4, a log), the ask (W4.2, analytics) and the published world (W3.1, a movement out of its zone); the model path is stzlib's and HaroBase's (the same rung). A CONSTRAINT gains SEVERITY (error or warning). The five other weaves stay carried and refused by name. Every v0.24 declaration still passes (A3 is v0.24's A1, unchanged); v0.23's R13 and R16 were amended with this rung and are recorded in v23/GRAMMAR.md. Rejects carry the fragment the refusal must contain.

accepts.name: a clinic under all six articles, both weaves constitutional, a regime and one personal seat the voice does not tell
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE clinic AS (VERSION "0.25", GRAMMAR "0.25", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".clinic") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU holders AS (WORDS [the_clinic, the_ministry, the_insurer]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU wards AS (WORDS [maternity, surgery, outpatients]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION patient AS (VERB "PATIENT", SEATS [full_name: text, file_no: text, ward: wards]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION registry AS (VERB "REGISTRY", SEATS [held_by: holders, entered_through: flow]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_verb AS (MESSAGE "The verb set is closed", CODE "UNKNOWN_VERB") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE clinic AS (POINTS [patient.full_name: field, patient.ward: knob], FLOOR [patient.full_name: external, patient.ward: trusted]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [patient: "{name} (file {file_no}) is on {ward}.", flow: "{name} is a flow.", registry: "{name} is held by {held_by}, entered through {entered_through}."], REFUSES "Stopped at line {line}: {message} ({cites})") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [explainability, reversibility, visible_state, predictable_authority, organizational_sovereignty, trust_hierarchy], ZONE registry, SOVEREIGN held_by, MOVEMENT entered_through, WEAVES [sovereignty: constitutional, privacy: constitutional], REGIME gdpr, PERSONAL [patient.full_name]) RATIONALE "the whole constitution, with its first two weaves"

accepts.name: privacy at governance severity: the voice tells the personal seat, and the sentence is accepted with a warning that names the weave, the article and the regime's own article
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE clinic AS (VERSION "0.25", GRAMMAR "0.25", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".clinic") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION patient AS (VERB "PATIENT", SEATS [full_name: text, file_no: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [patient: "{name} is {full_name}, file {file_no}."]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [visible_state], WEAVES [privacy: governance], REGIME gdpr, PERSONAL [patient.full_name]) RATIONALE "x"

expect.warning: W4.4 privacy: personal seat 'patient.full_name' is told by the voice -- a log carries no personal datum unredacted [Art. 5 organizational_sovereignty; gdpr: Article 5(1)(e)]

accepts.name: a v0.24 declaration is a v0.25 declaration: v0.24's A1, unchanged -- no WEAVES, no REGIME, no PERSONAL
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.24", GRAMMAR "0.24", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU holders AS (WORDS [the_bank, the_clearing_house]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text, ceiling: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION vault AS (VERB "VAULT", SEATS [held_by: holders, entered_through: flow]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_verb AS (MESSAGE "The verb set is closed", CODE "UNKNOWN_VERB") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE bank AS (POINTS [account.ceiling: knob], FLOOR [account.ceiling: external]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [account: "{name} is held by {holder} up to {ceiling}.", flow: "{name} is a flow.", vault: "{name} is held by {held_by}, entered through {entered_through}."], REFUSES "Stopped at line {line}: {message} ({cites})") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [explainability, reversibility, visible_state, predictable_authority, organizational_sovereignty, trust_hierarchy], ZONE vault, SOVEREIGN held_by, MOVEMENT entered_through) RATIONALE "the whole constitution"
